entities.summary: Mark Lajal is an Estonian tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of world No. 145, achieved on 22 September 2025. 703, achieved on 25 November 2024. He is currently the No. 1 Estonian player. He has won two ATP Challenger and three ITF singles titles.
